types.name: ToolApprovalProps
types.doc: An inline permission request inside a conversation: the agent names the tool and shows the arguments it wants to call it with, and the person allows it once, allows it from now on, or denies it. Once decided, the request folds into a single line that records the answer.

members.name: tool
members.doc: Name of the tool, as the agent calls it (for example "run_command").

members.name: args
members.doc: Arguments of the call: an object shown as key and value lines, or a ready-made string.

members.name: description
members.doc: Why the agent wants to run it, in a short sentence.

members.name: defaultDecision
members.doc: Decision the request starts with when uncontrolled.

members.name: onDecisionChange
members.doc: Called when the person decides, or reopens the request.

members.name: allowChange
members.doc: Shows a "Change" button on the result line that reopens the request.

members.name: labels
members.doc: Button and result texts, to translate or reword them.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
